look_here_first: Start with the tiny low habit and very narrow opposite leaves. Then confirm solitary short-axillary lavender flowers rather than the paired bracted cymes of Dicliptera.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: low rhizomatous perennial, often roughly 10–20 cm tall

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: opposite sessile to subsessile very narrow leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: purple bilabiate corolla with darker throat markings

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: capsule largely enclosed by persistent calyx

lookalikes.differences: Much lower and narrower-leaved than Dicliptera brachiata, with solitary axillary flowers instead of paired condensed cymes with conspicuous bracts.
